title: The fresh start effect: one day, two names
notes: Gritwerk-Format "Laborbuch", Reihe "Laborbuch" (Format-Bibel 1.0). layout.description: Is it easier to start on a day that sounds like a new beginning? In a published experiment with 165 people, the same day was called either "the first day of spring" or "the third Thursday in March". With the fresh-start name, 25.6 instead of 7.2 percent chose it for a goal reminder. Setup, measure, limits, and why "a 354% increase" is not right.
layout.companion_text: Gritwerk retells published experiments: setup, measure, result, limits, replication status. Not run by us.

beats.spoken: Is it easier to start on a day that sounds like a fresh start? One experiment renamed a single day, and three and a half times as many people chose it.

data.question: Is starting easier on a fresh start?
data.cite: Dai et al. 2015 · Psychol. Sci. 26(12) · Study 1A, Method

beats.spoken: Everyone named a goal for April and picked a day for a reminder email, from March eighteenth to twenty-fourth. For one group, March twentieth was the first day of spring. For the other, the third Thursday in March.

data.headline: How it worked
data.cite: Dai et al. 2015 · Psychol. Sci. 26(12) · Study 1A, Method

beats.spoken: The measure was a single choice: who picked exactly March twentieth? Whether anyone actually started their goal was not measured.

data.headline: Measured: one choice

sample.text: Not measured: whether the goal was started

data.cite: Dai et al. 2015 · Psychol. Sci. 26(12) · Study 1A, Method

beats.spoken: With the neutral name, just over seven percent chose that day. As the first day of spring, almost twenty-six. That is three and a half times as many. The paper says a three hundred fifty-four percent increase, correct would be about two hundred fifty.

data.headline: Result
data.cite: Dai et al. 2015 · Psychol. Sci. 26(12) · Study 1A, Results

beats.spoken: The limits: only people who wanted a reminder, a date as the measure, and small numbers. No independent replication of this experiment is known. The status is open.

limits.text: only people who wanted a reminder
measured: a date, not the goal
